metadata.title: Hodge--Riemann relations for $m$-positive and generalized $m$-positive forms
metadata.abstract: We study Hodge--Riemann relations for ordinary, sequential, and weak $m$-positive real $(1,1)$-forms in complex dimension $d$. For ordinary $m$-positive forms, we prove the fully mixed relations in every permitted bidegree without assuming semipositivity, generalizing results by Xiao. As a generalization of ordinary $m$-positivity, sequential $m$-positivity is defined by the hyperbolicity cones of successive directional derivatives of the determinant. We formulate a generalized mixed Hodge--Riemann conjecture for this condition and prove several cases beyond the scalar inequalities supplied by hyperbolicity. We also consider weak $m$-positivity which corresponds to the pointwise subsolution condition for the complex $m$-Hessian equation. In this setting, we prove the Hodge--Riemann relations for $p\neq q$ and in several diagonal cases, and show that the associated power map induces a pointwise diffeomorphism onto the cone of positive $(d-1,d-1)$-forms. Using Dinh and Nguyên's $L^2$ globalization method, we pass from the pointwise relations to cohomology classes on compact Kähler manifolds. Finally, we propose conjectures on a numerical criterion for sequential positivity and on solvability of the generalized $m$-Hessian equation.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 推广m正形式的混合Hodge–Riemann关系
analysis.workSummary: 对普通m正实(1,1)形式，在允许的全部双次数证明充分混合Hodge–Riemann关系而不加半正性。对行列式逐向导数hyperbolicity cone定义的sequential m正性提出广义猜想并证若干情形；对对应复m-Hessian subsolution条件的weak m正性，证p≠q及若干对角情形，并以L²方法全局化到紧Kähler上同调。
analysis.breakthrough: 扩充普通m正形式的混合双次数范围，并为两种更弱正性搭建局部与上同调理论。
analysis.limitations: 普通、sequential、weak三种正性结果不同；广义混合关系、数值准则及广义m-Hessian可解性仍含未解猜想，不得概括全部证完。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
